kan CID shortcut display notation: a CID renders compactly as '@' + the 7 characters following the shared 'bafyrei' prefix + an ellipsis. Example: bafyreictf6g6fq4covvtzxwdxahadplft4wu2fx5ohtv7gtnb37jsful3y displays as @ctf6g6f… . Use it wherever CIDs appear compactly (cites lists, claim references in the browser); show the full CID where identity or copy matters (a claim's own detail header). A CID that does not start with 'bafyrei' falls back to '@' + its first 7 chars + ellipsis.
